data.title: Wire SECRET_KEY and DEBUG to DJANGO_SECRET_KEY/DJANGO_DEBUG env vars

data.to: docker-compose.yml already passes DJANGO_SECRET_KEY and DJANGO_DEBUG to the web container, but app/config/settings.py hardcodes SECRET_KEY (line 24) and DEBUG = True (line 27), so both env vars are silently ignored. Wire them up following the exact pattern HDT-3 (POSTGRES_*) and HDT-4 (DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS) established: os.environ.get with a dev-safe default. SECRET_KEY default = the current insecure dev key (keeps fresh clones working with zero setup); DEBUG parses DJANGO_DEBUG truthily — compose and .env.example use '1'/'0', so define the parse rule explicitly (e.g. value in ('1','true','yes') case-insensitive) and keep default True for dev. Requested directly by Forrest during the README audit; the audit finding is recorded in the previous session summary.
